skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the structure of general optimization problems and how to formulate them from economic and financial issues.
Use necessary and sufficient conditions for optimality to find and classify extremum points of functions on given constraint sets.
Apply knowledge of linear programming problems and dual problems to solve specific problems.
Use basic commands in R software and apply it to solve some optimization problems.
Flexibly use the simplex algorithm one phase to solve linear programming problems and apply software skills to program solutions.
Flexibly use the simplex algorithm two phases to solve linear programming problems and apply software skills to program solutions.
Develop decision-making skills and take responsibility.
Adapt well to changes in external factors.
Apply Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions to solve constrained optimization problems.
Use Excel software to solve linear programming problems.
Analyze properties of a solution using dual problem characteristics when the optimal solution of another problem is known.
